    # 3 beams, each 1.0m width, 0.08m height => total area 3 * 1.0 * 0.08 = 0.24 m²
    # Target mass 1.6 kg => density = 1.6 / 0.24 ≈ 6.6667 kg/m²
    DENSITY = 1.6 / (3 * 1.0 * 0.08)
